change_summary: Research-only NBA ingestion guard v2 at the board-loader boundary, isolated from #536. All source kinds pass one universal validation (event identity, strict integer odds, period, selection, line/complement, capture chronology) before pricing; invalid rows go to a persisted rejection ledger with reason codes; player props are validated too; each run uses a unique atomic workspace. models/nba/sportsedge_nba_model.py (blob b353de86) is not edited. PAPER/0u, NON_COUNTED.
assumptions: Frozen run_card/price_games/price_game_market/price_props/__main__ remain for frozen-file regression tests only. The frozen __main__ cannot be guarded without editing blob b353de86, so it stays reachable as a script; the census test fails if any other module, workflow or script reaches frozen pricing.

Tie/Draw semantics follow DraftKings General Rules C.ii (a two-selection market with no Tie/Draw settles a tie as Push), cited with URLs, retrieval times and sha256 in pr-536.json. Tie selections never reach two-way pricing.

Quotes need capture_id plus tz-aware captured_at at or before tip-off and the run as-of time. Captures are never paired; the newest valid capture wins and older ones are ledgered. This is structural chronology, not source authentication.

Prices must be whole-number American quotes with abs value >= 100 and coherent two-sided hold. PDF and screenshot inputs fail closed unless structured rows are supplied; no parser is added. Roster checks verify structure, not player availability.
No promotion, no certification, no source authentication, official_counted=0, approved_stake_u=0, PAPER/0u, NON_COUNTED.
